_comment: Cards that exist only for the Dracogenesis permission test (tests/unit/test_free_cast_permission.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_dragon_amnesty` is Dracogenesis' one line on a free enchantment, so the board can be set without the mana to cast the granter. `t_cinder_wyrm` is a Dragon whose cost is mostly coloured pips -- the half a `spell_cost_reduction` can never reach, since reductions are clamped to the generic part -- and `t_cinder_ogre` is the same card with the Dragon type filed off, which is how the filter's scope is measured. `t_swelling_wyrmling` is an {X} Dragon that enters with X +1/+1 counters, so 107.3b's 'X is 0' is a printed number on the battlefield rather than a field nobody looks at.

cards.name: Test Dragon Amnesty
cards.oracle_text: You may cast Dragon spells without paying their mana costs.

abilities.text: You may cast Dragon spells without paying their mana costs.

cards.name: Test Swelling Wyrmling
cards.oracle_text: Test Swelling Wyrmling enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
